IRAN ONLY UNDERSTANDS STRENGTH

@AriFleischer: “The media is always going to be against what Donald Trump does.”

“It was tough talk—but it was fluent in FARSI… the language they understand in Iran.”

“There was no deal BEFORE that message—there was AFTER.”

Video

“TRUMP TAKES CHARGE”

@realKTMcFarland: “Most presidents sit and listen… Donald Trump immediately TAKES CHARGE of the room.”

“He peppers everyone with questions—the one you haven’t thought of.”

“At the end of the day, he doesn’t say ‘I’ll think about it’—he MAKES A DECISION and lives with it.”

Video

Tom Sauer: "From WORLD WAR III to CEASEFIRE"

“Barely 24 hours ago… the world thought we were on the brink of WORLD WAR III.”

“Now we have a CEASEFIRE—a de-clawed Iran on its way to being DENUCLEARIZED.”

“Oil flows increasing… and now real INCENTIVES to keep the Strait open.”

Video

Michael Allen on Iran: “WATCH VERY CAREFULLY”

“Just because we’re getting into a deal… doesn’t mean we can TRUST them.”

“We have to WATCH this very, very carefully—verify everything through intelligence.”

“We’ve substantially DEGRADED their capabilities… now let’s see what happens this weekend.”

Video

China and its supporters in the press trying to get credit.  I thought the press had told us that China was winning.  If China was winning, why did it want a ceasefire?


The Associated Press (@AP)

Chinese officials encouraged Iran to look for a path toward a ceasefire in the war with the U.S., AP sources say. apnews.com/live/iran-war-isr…




— https://nitter.net/AP/status/2041682922529288509#m

Spanberger pushed a 9–2 map.

@bdomenech: “The idea that she’s some kind of MODERATE… it was always BS.”

“She was always a LEFTIST—lockstep with the partisans running things.”

“Voters were told one thing… now they’re seeing something very different.”

Video

Minneapolis considers legalizing SEX CLUBS.

@GrageDustin: “At the end of the day… they still want to push this through.”

“Even within that community—there’s support for it.”

“This is what the democratic socialist campaign wants to push.”

Video

“SOLD AS MODERATE—GOVERNING AS LIBERAL”

@MattTowery:  “Spanberger’s really not a moderate… she’s an ultra liberal—and that’s what she’s turned out to be.”

“They sold Jon Ossoff the same way—moderate in the campaign, liberal in office.”

“This is their new playbook… and now voters are finding out what they got.”

Video

“A GREAT DAY FOR AMERICA”

@GordonGChang: “The Chinese saw a determined President Trump get his way… this is a great day for America.”

“They don’t want to stand up to the United States—they know they don’t have the power.”

“Trump is making history… and they feel they can’t do anything about it.”

Video

ADM. HARWARD: “DETERRENCE IS BACK”

“If they open the strait and stuff starts flowing tomorrow—it’s a huge victory for the president.”

“We had lost all deterrence… they didn’t fear the United States. That’s changed—deterrence is back on the table.”

“The Iranians know he was going to take them to the Stone Ages… now we watch what they do.”

Video

DEADLINE OFF. CEASEFIRE ON.

Iran blinked. 

After direct talks, Trump pauses strikes for two weeks—says negotiations are “incredibly complex” but moving toward a definitive agreement.

Video

“DEAD ON ARRIVAL”

@AmbNathanSales: “Their wish list was exactly that—a fantasy wish list.”

“Withdraw all forces? Not going to happen. Reparations? Not going to happen. Control of the Strait of Hormuz? Dead on arrival.”

“This is all subject to Iran opening the Strait—now we watch what Tehran does.”

Video
A moving Easter Vigil with 80+ young people coming into the faith at St Joseph’s Church, Greenwich Village, NYC.  Each one has his own journey. God is good!

“Highly-skilled” tech workers = industrial-scale fraud + job and wage theft of American workers.


CBS Evening News with Tony Dokoupil (@CBSEveningNews)

For decades, the U.S. has imported highly-skilled tech workers from around the world on H-1B visas. But the Trump administration changed the way they are granted. CBS News’ Shanelle Kaul reports on how that is impacting the pipeline of global talent coming to America.

Video

Never should have been issued.


New York Post (@nypost)

Gordon Chang: “Iran’s nuclear program exists because of CHINA.”
